_comment: ERP config for Plane (analog of appsettings.json). Loaded into env by settings/common.py. Real env vars override these. DB_* creds are NOT here — pass them as env (like the ERP services' .env). Copy to erp_config.json (gitignored) with real values, mount it at /code/erp_config.json or point ERP_CONFIG_JSON at it.
